step2.heading: Uzakoresha VerifyAI ute?

step2.notice: <bold>Konti z'Ikigo cy'itangazamakuru n'iza Umuyobozi</bold> zishyirwaho n'umuyobozi w'urubuga. Niba umuryango wawe ukeneye imwe, nyamuneka vugana n'umuyobozi wawe nyuma yo gufungura konti y'Umuturage.

step3.subtitleJournalist: Hitamo ijambobanga rikomeye wongereho ikigo cyawe cy'itangazamakuru.

strength.weak: Rifite intege nke — ongeraho uburebure, inyuguti nkuru, imibare, cyangwa ibimenyetso.
